description: The Mahindra Maxx is an offroad Pickup truck which was launched in 2001 in nine- or ten-seat station wagon form. It replaced the earlier Armada Station Wagon. Mahindra & Mahindra took it out of production in 2010. From September 2003 on this vehicle was also available in pick-up variants known as the Maxx maxitruck or Maxx Pik Up. There was also a better equipped wagon version called the Maxx LX.
